mode.description:
When the cancellation takes effect. Required.

`immediate` stops the subscription now: `status` becomes `canceled` and no further cycles are scheduled. `at_period_end` sets `cancel_at_period_end` to `true` and leaves `status` unchanged; the subscription becomes `canceled` when the next cycle would have been generated.
